author: dannymarshlax
quote:
Why the story is boring? And locking some content behind paid doors are crazy. I waited so long and got disappointed so quick into the game. The idea of not being to steal cars from own neighbourhood is total bs.
I don't mind doing task for someone in a game, but why it has to be in the very start? Whoever it is, should earn it, and its the writers job to make it happen. Instead it feels like "some **** b is gonna appreciate it so you better do it" 
Coming after playing a game that runs at 120fps, it was very hard to get into it.
GTA6 is the most awaited game in the world not because its great, but because it stood on the shoulders of giants(previous gta series)!
Also, for  a game that was developed for very long time, the amount crashes and bugs are crazy. 
Adding to this, autosave only saves after some important missions. If the game crashes midway some progress are lost.
Wait for a discount or mods, it might get worthy.
